title: Agent Harness Awareness: Turning Verified Telemetry into Operational Control for Tool-Using Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.05391v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tool descriptions tell an agent what an action can do, but they do not necessarily reveal whether that action is healthy or suitable at the moment of use. Execution harnesses often possess this information through monitors, traces, and recent failures while the model choosing the next action does not. We call this gap operational blindness. We introduce Agent Harness Awareness, a trust-separated design in which the host supplies a small, fresh, verified state snapshot before a consequential action while retaining measurement, enforcement, evaluation, and final dispatch authority. We test its tools-and-network instance with ToolRoute, a controlled isolation benchmark that holds the task and candidate semantics constant and varies the operational information available to the model. In a 216-decision ablation across GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Sonnet 5, and Gemini 3.7 Flash, verified tool-health state reduced mean observable policy regret by 96.9%

translated_title: 智能体执行框架感知：将经验证的遥测数据转化为工具调用智能体的运行控制
translated_abstract: 工具描述告诉智能体某个操作能够做什么，但不一定揭示该操作在使用时刻是否健康或适用。执行框架通常通过监控器、追踪记录和近期故障掌握这些信息，而选择下一步操作的模型却无从得知。我们将这一差距称为“运行盲区”。我们提出“智能体执行框架感知”，这是一种信任分离的设计：在执行关键操作之前，由宿主向模型提供一份小型、最新且经过验证的状态快照，同时保留测量、强制执行、评估和最终分发的权限。我们使用ToolRoute测试其工具与网络实例，ToolRoute是一个受控隔离基准，它在保持任务和候选语义不变的情况下，仅改变模型可获得的运行信息。在涵盖GPT-5.6 Sol、Claude Sonnet 5和Gemini 3.7 Flash的216次决策消融实验中，经验证的工具健康状态使平均可观测策略遗憾降低了96.9%。
tldr: 提出名为“智能体执行框架感知”的信任分离设计，由宿主在关键操作前向模型提供经验证的最新运行状态快照，弥补模型对执行框架运行信息的“运行盲区”，使三种主流模型上的平均可观测策略遗憾降低96.9%。
en_tdlr: Agent Harness Awareness is a trust-separated design in which the host supplies a fresh, verified state snapshot before each consequential action, closing the "operational blindness" gap for tool-using agents and reducing mean observable policy regret by 96.9% across three frontier models.
